comparison.objective: Tighten a locknut in a restricted 44-degree wrench-swing space.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeatedly engage, turn, disengage, flip, and re-engage an open-end wrench.
comparison.success_condition: Nut rotated to its seated stop and held, with partial credit by achieved angle.
comparison.reason: Restricted-access wrench indexing does not test granular-flow orientation or screening yield.
